name: The Living Room
body: Vast, high-ceilinged, the largest shared space in the house — big enough to hold all sixty-plus girls when both houses gather, sprawling enough for daily chaos when it is only the thirty-two. Sectional sofas and layered throw rugs for smaller piles. A media alcove with the big screen and the consoles, movie-night command centre and site of Rae's legendary Mario Kart losing streak, which she insists is rigged. Bay windows line one wall with built-in seats where Torie, Luna and Livi curl with tea and paperbacks on slow mornings.
